messages:
lina: quick flag from staging smoke: quant build v3.2.1-q failed artifact verify AND we saw 2 OOMs on long-seq in the staging canary. posting logs.
raj: link to smoke job?
lina: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/engine-release/789 (see step: package+smoke). packaging step printed mismatch then the smoke run hit OOM on two pods.
drew: can you paste the packaging output snippet?
ci-bot: Artifact verification: expected sha256=def456, computed sha256=abc123. Verification failed.
lina: snippet:
```
> packaging: building engine:v3.2.1-q
> writing s3://artifacts/engine/v3.2.1-q/build-789.tar.gz
> computed sha256=abc123
> expected sha256=def456
> ERROR: verification failed
```
olga: that explains the checksum. but the OOMs are concerning. which tests did OOM?
lina: long-seq perf test, 64k tokens synthetic. two T4 pods in eu-west-1 OOMed after ~1200 steps. no CPU spike, memory climbed steadily.
raj: hypothesis: padding/alignment change in quant matmul increased per-shard scratch. can we pin and stop canary? propose immediate pin and reduce canary to 0%.
drew: agree. also set short TTL so we don't forget. recommend /deploy pin with ttl=90 and note="pack+oom-staging-hold"
olga: also we should verify packaging provenance before unpin. if artifact checksum mismatch, someone tampered or CI race. re-run release pipeline with --verify.
deploybot: Usage: `/deploy pin <target> --scope=<scope> --ttl=<minutes> --note="<reason>"`
raj: I'll run the pin. `/deploy pin engine:v3.2.1-q --scope=staging-canary --ttl=90 --note="pack+oom-staging-hold"`
deploybot: Command acknowledged. engine:v3.2.1-q pinned (scope=staging-canary, ttl=90m, note=pack+oom-staging-hold). Pin timestamp: 2024-06-xxTxx:xx:xxZ. To remove: `/deploy unpin engine:v3.2.1-q`.
olga: action items: (1) re-run packaging (ci-bot) (2) run mem/perf regression with longer trace (3) open hotfix branch if packaging rebuild still large (4) if OOM in any prod canary -> rollback to v3.2.0 and page oncall.
drew: set telemetry alert: OOM_count_by_region > 1 in 10m -> page eng-sre + start rollback runbook. I'll open alert now.
ci-bot: Re-run queued: `./ci/release.sh --artifact v3.2.1-q --rebuild --verify` (job #790).
lina: I'm creating hotfix branch `hotfix/quant-pad-revert` and will try backporting the alignment delta from v3.2.0. requesting review from @raj.
raj: got it. if rebuild produces identical checksum -> likely nondeterministic packaging; need to harden. if rebuild differs -> investigate CI image/version drift.
olga: release-notes draft: adding a short hold note: "Hold: quant kernel release (v3.2.1-q) due to artifact verification failure and staging canary OOMs. Investigating packaging checksum and memory regression."
drew: timeline: packaging rebuild ~10m; mem tests ~20m after that. hotfix PR ETA 40-60m. will update thread.
ci-bot: job #790 started. artifacts will be uploaded to s3://artifacts/engine/v3.2.1-q/rebuild-790/
lina: thanks all. ping here once job completes. if rebuild passes verify AND memory profile unchanged we still should not unpin until a controlled 5% canary with 2h stable window.
raj: agreed. rollback rule restated: any prod canary OOM >=1 within 5m -> immediate rollback to engine:v3.2.0 and incident. staging OOMs: if >=3 in 30m -> rollback.
olga: noted. keeping this concise for release notes and incident doc. :warning:
